text:
Eli: Quick sync 1: need a tight run-of-show and follow-up plan for the May 26 webinar. Theme: "Inference playbooks for product teams". Goal: show 2 tactical demos, 1 short customer vignette, and clear next steps for attendees.
Sofia: Agree. Keep main session to 40m and a 20m technical breakout.
Noah: Speakers: Sofia demo 1 (caching), Marta demo 2 (quant+latency), Priya customer vignette. All confirmed?
Priya: Confirmed. I9ll provide a 6-minute customer vignette + 2-slide summary.
Marta: Demo will include a short before/after cost table and a 90s pre-recorded fallback clip. Upload to s3 by 5/22.
Eli: Run-of-show draft: 0:00-3:00 host intro+agenda, 3:00-9:00 customer vignette, 9:00-20:00 demo 1 (Sofia), 20:00-30:00 demo 2 (Marta), 30:00-36:00 panel takeaways, 36:00-40:00 Q&A, 40:00-60:00 optional tech breakout.
Sofia: Add a 60s break slide between demos to allow swap.
Noah: Rehearsals: green-room run 5/24 10:00 PT, dress 5/25 11:00 PT. Please confirm availability.
Marta: 5/24 works. I9ll need 30m green-room before the run.
Priya: Request: please build one poll mid-session: "Which lever will you try next? Caching / Quantization / Batching". Use results to route attendees to playbook variants.
Eli: Good. Registration form fields: name, email, company, role, primary interest (product/infra), preferred follow-up (playbook/demo). Noah, you own the form.
Noah: On it. Will add hidden utm=may26_inference_playbook and tag mapping.
Eli: Follow-up sequencing: Immediate replay + short TL;DR email within 24h. 3-day follow-up with playbook for product tag and bench harness for infra tag. 10-day SDR outreach for high-engagement leads. Who owns copy?
Sofia: I can draft the 24h replay email and short TL;DR. Priya will draft the playbook.
Priya: Yep 5 will draft a 1-page playbook and a deep-link to our repo.
Eli: Deck owners: send slides to /marketing/shared/decks/may26 by 5/23 noon. I will do a narrative pass 5/24 16:00 PT.
Marta: Also include two benchmark slides comparing cost/latency for hosted vs dedicated at 4k context. I'll produce a config snippet for the notes.
Sofia: Ops asks: captions and transcript, host spotlighting, and gated replay. Hosting-bot can confirm caption availability?
hosting-bot: Live English captions available in us-west-2. Transcript generation and SRT export available post-event. Gated replay support confirmed.
Noah: Engagement CTA: add a short form on replay that asks which follow-up resource they want and triggers the appropriate nurture path.
Eli: Good. Analytics: track attendance rate, poll responses, replay watch time, and follow-up conversions. Noah will wire events to CDP.
Noah: Will add CDP events and set utm mapping.
Sofia: Small request: show one transparent cost slide with $/1k tokens for the demo path. Attendees appreciate raw numbers.
Marta: Will include a small table and an annotated note about assumptions.
Priya: Speaker bios + two-line abstracts due 5/20 EOD. Paste here when ready.
Sofia: Abstract: "Practical caching patterns to cut token spend and tail latency." Bio: "Sofia 1 Staff Engineer, runtime caching lead."
Marta: Abstract: "Balancing quantization and kernel choices for predictable latency at scale." Bio: "Marta 3 Runtime Engineer, benchmarks & quantization."
Priya: Customer blurb coming 5/19 morning.
Eli: Final checklist: backup clips uploaded, slides in folder, captions vendor confirmed, poll configured, reg form live, follow-up copy drafted. Let's mark owners and close by EOD 5/23.
Noah: I'll ping when the form is live.
Eli: Thanks team 1. We'll lock the final run-of-show after green-room. :rocket:
